Rooms.Name: Floating In The Air
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself floating about 50 meters above the ground. You see the
soft ground below you and suddenly wish that you were firmly planted there.

Exits.Description:
Above you can barely make out what seems to be a large structure reaching
towards the heavens.
Below you see the Mountain of the Gods.

Rooms.Name: Flying in the Air
Rooms.Description:
You are flying quite high above the ground. You think you can see your house
off to the left! Something very big is also directly above and to the south of
you.

Exits.Description: Above you is a large, fluffy cloud.
Below will take you closer to the ground. . . it looks safer.

Rooms.Name: A Fluffy Cloud
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a fluffy cloud before a large structure of sorts. You
notice that the structure is covered in gold and some sort of writing covers
the outside of the great doors.

Exits.Description: To the south lies a glowing temple.
Below you is the path back towards land. . . you might better head that way.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to Temple
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself standing in the entrance to the great Temple of the
Samurai. This temple glows golden and is a tribute to all of the great warriors
of the past. You feel as if you have intruded where mortals were never meant to
tread.

Exits.Description: North of you is the exit to the temple.
South you notice a flower filled room.

Rooms.Name: Ceremonial Gardens
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a brightly lit room. All around you are flowers and
wild herbs. A message scribbled on the wall tells you that this is where the
warriors prepared gifts for their sick companions.

Exits.Description: North of you is the entrance hall of the temple.
East of you is another room in the temple.

Rooms.Name: Hospital
Rooms.Description:
You are in a room filled with empty cots. Elixirs and herbs line the walls.
Books cover the shelves. The room itself has an antiseptic smell and reminds
you of a hospital.

Exits.Description: North is the abode of the shogun.
You see the gardens back to the west.

Rooms.Name: Shogun of Jin
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a peaceful abode. Before you stands the Shogun of Jin.
Although you don't know exactly what Jin means, you feel that this man can
teach you much about people. Stairs lead upward to the next level.

Exits.Description: To the south lies the hospital.
A golden stairway leads you ever upward.

Rooms.Name: Homely Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself standing in a homely looking hallway. This room reminds
you of your youth and brings back images of your parents teaching you right
from wrong.

Exits.Description: South lead to another room.
To the west is another room.
A golden stairway leads you downward.

Rooms.Name: Another Room
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in another room similar to that you just came from. You
can't particularly tell any differences in this room at all.

Exits.Description: East leads back where you came from.

Rooms.Name: Yet Another Room
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself standing in yet another room. Your mind reels as you
discover this room is the same as the one you just came from!

Exits.Description: North is where you came from.
East leads to a room that LOOKS different.

Rooms.Name: Shogun of Gi
Rooms.Description:
You finally find yourself in a different room! You see the Shogun of Gi
standing before you pointing his finger and lecturing you for killing his
fellow Shogun. Now you gonna get it!

Exits.Description: East is where you came from.
A stairway leads upward.

Rooms.Name: Third Floor Landing
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself on a landing of the third floor of the temple. Your legs
ache from all the climbing and you wonder to yourself exactly how many floors
this place has.

Exits.Description: To the east you see a slave chamber.

Rooms.Name: Slave Chamber
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a room full of slaves. The slaves, however, have no
chains, shackles, or bondage devices of any kind. These people are voluntary
slaves to their master . . . the Shogun of Chu. They don't feel worthy to be
anything else. Do you?

Exits.Description: To the north you hear sounds of metalworking.
The west is where you were a minute ago!

Rooms.Name: Metal Shop
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a metalworking shop. The trainees here are pounding
their swords and other weapons into razor sharp tools of defense. You watch as
they continue to pound away and think to yourself 'Hmm... I wonder if they
would temper my sword?'

Exits.Description: South leads to the slave chamber.
You see another Shogun chamber to your west.

Rooms.Name: Shogun of Chu
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself standing in the chamber of the Shogun of Chu. All around
him you notice warriors who are completely loyal to their master. You better
not try to mess with this guy . . .

Exits.Description: Sounds of metalworking come from the east.
Stairs lead upward yet again.

Rooms.Name: Fourth Floor Landing
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the fourth floor of the temple. You have traveled much
too far already, but feel that going onward is a must. Something about this
floor demands respect.

Exits.Description: You hear water to the south.
Stairs lead down from here.

Rooms.Name: The bath
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a public bath. Samurai's walk around in towels and glare
at you for intruding. You have a strange feeling that no one should ever
interrupt a samurai while he's bathing.

Exits.Description: A landing is to your north.
The antechamber is to your east.

Rooms.Name: The Antechamber of Ko
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the antechamber of the Shogun of Ko. The room is brightly
colored and the walls are filled with inscriptions honoring fathers and mothers
of the samurai who abide here.

Exits.Description: To the north is the chamber of the Shogun.
Water can be heard to the west.

Rooms.Name: Shogun of Ko
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the chamber of the Shogun of Ko. This shogun looks
exactly like your father. In fact, he looks exactly like anyone's father. You
expect to see him pull his belt and whip you at any moment... then you notice
his weapon.

Exits.Description: The antechamber lies to the south.
A ladder leads upward.

Rooms.Name: Fifth Floor Landing
Rooms.Description:
You are on the landing of the fifth floor of this mammoth temple. You have a
feeling that you still have quite a ways to go, however. You notice drawings on
the wall telling of the respectful warriors of long ago.

Exits.Description: Grinding sounds come from the south.
The antechamber lies to the west.

Rooms.Name: Weapons Room
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the weapons room. You see warriors standing before
primitive, yet very effective, tools for putting a razor's edge on swords. It
looks like they could really put a hurtin' on someone with their weapons.

Exits.Description: A landing is to your north.

Rooms.Name: The antechamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in the Antechamber of the Shogun. This room is full of paintings of
warriors, written declarations of respect for fellow Samurai, and what seems to
be a grocery list.

Exits.Description: A landing is to your east.
The Shogun's chamber is south of you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The list reads:
		Eggs
		Flour
		Condoms

Rooms.Name: Shogun of Rei
Rooms.Description:
You are in the chamber of the Shogun of Rei. The Shogun here knows well of
the value of other people. In fact, he even respects your insignificant
carcass. Hmm . . . how odd, no one else does.

Exits.Description: The antechamber is north of you.
A stairway leads up from here.

Rooms.Name: Sixth Floor Landing
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the landing of the sixth floor. The muscles in your body
ache, you're thirsty, you haven't eaten for some time, and now would be a good
time to rest some.

Exits.Description: A strange humming is north of you.
Yet another antechamber is west.
Stairs lead down from here.

Rooms.Name: Machine Room
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a large room filled with computers. This room is where
the samurai must learn word processing skills that they are known to have. Kewl
huh?

Exits.Description: A landing is south of you.

Rooms.Name: The antechamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in the antechamber of yet another Shogun. You faintly remember
hearing somewhere that there are about eight basic principles of the samurai.
Only three more to go . . .

Exits.Description: The Shogun chamber is north.
The landing is to your east.

Rooms.Name: Shogun of Chi
Rooms.Description:
You stand before the Shogun of Chi. His glowing aura tells you that he is
not only extremely good, but VERY wise. You think that this wise individual
could indeed teach you quite a few things about life.

Exits.Description: The antechamber is to the south.
A ladder leads upward.

Rooms.Name: The Seventh Floor Landing
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the landing of the seventh floor of the temple. The
walls are very clean and the writings on the wall tell of crusades for truth.
You wish you truthfully knew how many darn rooms were in this temple.

Exits.Description: South of you comes the sounds of scribes.

Rooms.Name: Hall of Truth
Rooms.Description:
You stare at the scribes who seem oblivious to your presence. But upon
looking closer, you find that no scribes are in fact even in this room! You
notice that truth is not all within the realm of sight. Nifty idea ain't it??

Exits.Description: A landing is to your north.
To your east you hear cheers.

Rooms.Name: Courtyard
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the courtyard of the seventh floor. You seemed to have
come in during some form of competition. Warriors are sparring against each
other as the younger trainees look on with awe.

Exits.Description: North is the Shogun's chamber.
Sounds of writing come from the west.

Rooms.Name: Shogun of Shin
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the chamber dedicated to the Shogun of Shin. His clothing is
bright and powerful. His eyes are piercing. He glares at you, frowns, and draws
his sword. He knows why you are here.

Exits.Description: The courtyard is south of you.
Stairs lead upward

Rooms.Name: Eighth Floor Landing
Rooms.Description:
You have finally reached the eighth floor, the final floor in this bizarre
and twisted world that mirrors ancient Japan. But wait a minute, you glance out
a nearby window and find that you are not at the top yet. You sigh and continue
onward.

Exits.Description: South of here is something.
West of here is something.

Rooms.Name: Shogun of Tei
Rooms.Description:
You stand before the Shogun of Tei. This Shogun is the man you always see in
ancient pictures who is helping the aged and humble. You find that this man
looks at you with a caring glance and almost shows you pity before he draws his
weapon.

Exits.Description: A landing is north of you.
Stairs lead upwards from here.

Rooms.Name: An Empty Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in an empty room. There is nothing in the room. Furniture is not
here, lights are not here (although the walls DO glow). It's rather odd.

Exits.Description: A landing is to your east.
Something lies to your south.

Rooms.Name: Musty Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a musty room. You see some older, more experienced samurai here
in a semicircular group around a mark on the floor. They glance up at you and
scream death cries. You kinda stumbled in on a private party . . .

Exits.Description: North of here is an empty room.

Rooms.Name: The Top
Rooms.Description:
You have finally reached the top of the temple! You find yourself staring
face to face with the ultimate Samurai himself. His presence is overwhelming!
Many people have made guesses about death and dying. Looks like your questions
will soon be answered.

Mobs.Name: Samurai Trainee
Mobs.LongDescription: A Samurai Trainee is standing here trying to gather lost Karma.
Mobs.Description:
You see before you a young Samurai.  His clothes and weapon indicate that he
is only a trainee.

Mobs.Name: Samurai Apprentice
Mobs.LongDescription: An apprentice looking Samurai is meditating here.
Mobs.Description:
You see a samurai apprentice standing before you.  He looks much like a
trainee, but you can't quite tell.

Mobs.Name: Samurai Warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: A Samurai Warrior is here trying to look grim.
Mobs.Description:
You find yourself before one of the greatest warriors of all time.  And, from
the looks of his weapon, he is ready to fight.

Mobs.Name: Shogun of Understanding
Mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Understanding is here pondering on something.
Mobs.Description:
The Shogun of Understanding glows with goodness and stares straight at you as
if he knows something.

Mobs.Name: Shogun of Ethics
Mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Ethics is offended by your appearance.
Mobs.Description:
The Shogun of Ethics towers over you.  From the sight of his bloodied sword,
you decide not to be 'judged'.

Mobs.Name: Shogun of Loyalty
Mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Loyalty is here, panting, as if he just fled from something.
Mobs.Description:
The Shogun of Loyalty stands tall and proud.  You think that he might be a good
friend to have.

Mobs.Name: Shogun of Respect
Mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Respect is here, polishing his ancient sword.
Mobs.Description:
You see a huge figure grasping a spear-like weapon.  His presence alone is
enough to demand respect.

Mobs.Name: Shogun of Authority
Mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Authority demands something from you.
Mobs.Description:
This man reminds you of everything you ever feared in a parent. You want to
run back to your room.

Mobs.Name: Shogun of Knowledge
Mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Knowledge exclaims occasionally 'Eureka!'
Mobs.Description:
The Shogun of Knowledge merely looks at you, making you wonder what he really
knows.

Mobs.Name: Shogun of Truth
Mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Truth stands here muttering riddles.
Mobs.Description:
This guy is mean, strong, and has a bigger weapon than you.
He scares you ... no lie.

Mobs.Name: Shogun of Caring
Mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Caring is here tucking flowers into his belt.
Mobs.Description:
The Shogun of Caring reminds you somewhat of your father.  You just wanna give
him a great big hug!

Mobs.Name: Tokugawa Yoshikatsu
Mobs.Description:
Tokugawa Yoshikatsu was one of the greatest Samurai to ever kill a man.  And,
soon, either you or he will die.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: What an odd looking amulet!

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The amulet has many strange markings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The amulet has many strange markings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The amulet has many strange markings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The amulet has many strange markings.

Objects.Description: A mighty looking blade is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see the mighty Fugu Blade

Objects.Name: Sun Jewel
Objects.ShortDescription: a Jewel of the Rising Sun
Objects.Description: A bring yellow jewel seems to glow where it lies.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You notice that the stone glows like the sun.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This necklace looks like it belongs to someone.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Laroche looks like a sabre.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Ninjato looks very dangerous.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Azami looks very dangerous.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Katana looks very dangerous.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Wakisashi looks very dangerous.

Objects.Name: weapon kora
Objects.Description: Another strange weapon can be found here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Kora looks very dangerous.

Objects.Name: sword iaito

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Iaito looks very dangerous.

Objects.Name: sword mandarain dau
Objects.Description: A dangerous evil-looking sword has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Mandarain dau looks very dangerous.

Objects.Name: vest samurai
Objects.Description: A samurai vest lies here collecting dust.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a vest of great craftsmanship.  Stamped on the side is:
Samurai Industries

Objects.Name: bracer samurai
Objects.Description: Bracers of odd design lie here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a bracer of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries
